# Toster — Food Delivery Chain Management Platform

## What is Toster?

Toster is an all-in-one CRM and operations platform built specifically for food delivery chains.
It consolidates order management, kitchen display, courier tracking, customer loyalty, marketing
automation, and AI into a single platform — replacing 5 or more separate tools.

Toster is made by ADS L.L.C-FZ (Meydan Grandstand, 6th Floor, Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba, Dubai, UAE).
The platform is used daily by 966 Network — a real food delivery chain operating in
Ukraine, Poland, Czech Republic, and Germany — and is now open to external operators.

## Who is Toster for?

- Food delivery chains with 1 to 300+ locations
- Ghost kitchen operators and dark kitchens
- Restaurant groups expanding into delivery
- Multi-country food delivery operators

## What is included in the Toster package?

1. **CRM Platform** — Order management (Kanban + table view), kitchen display system (KDS),
   real-time courier tracking with route optimisation, POS terminal, customer loyalty program
   (1% cashback, promo codes, RFM segmentation), analytics dashboard, and inventory management.

2. **Customer Website** — A fully branded ordering website on your domain: menu, cart, checkout,
   loyalty integration, and real-time order tracking.

3. **iOS & Android Apps** — Native mobile apps published under your brand on the App Store
   and Google Play. White-label: your name, icon, and splash screen.

4. **Managed Marketing** — Email, SMS, push notifications, Viber, and Telegram campaigns
   managed end-to-end by the Toster team. Includes A/B testing and multi-touch attribution.

5. **AI Automation** — Claude-powered AI agent for reactivation flows, route optimisation,
   demand forecasting, abandoned cart recovery, and an AI voice operator for phone orders.

## Pricing

Toster pricing is revenue-based, not a flat monthly fee:
- 3% of monthly turnover — single location, core CRM only
- 5–7% — multi-location chain with managed marketing and AI automation
- Up to 9% — enterprise, large chains, custom integrations

There are no per-seat charges, no hidden fees, and no lock-in past year one.

## Key differentiators vs. competitors (iiko, Poster, Syrve, custom builds)

- Built by operators: Toster was created to run 966 Network, not as a generic SaaS
- Multi-country native: fiscalization for UA, PL, CZ, DE, ES, US included
- AI-first: Claude AI is integrated throughout, not bolted on
- Revenue-aligned pricing: operators pay more only when they earn more
- Full package: CRM + website + mobile apps + marketing — one contract

## Supported countries / fiscalization

Ukraine (Checkbox), Poland (KSeF), Czech Republic (EET), Germany (Fiskaly),
Spain (VeriFacTu), United States (Stripe Tax)

## Supported integrations

Bolt Food, Glovo, Wolt, Uber Eats, Raketa, Poster POS, iiko, Checkbox (UA fiscal),
LiqPay, Stripe, Google Maps, DistanceMatrix.ai, SendPulse, Meta Ads, Google Ads,
Telegram, Viber, ElevenLabs (AI voice), Cloudflare R2, Google BigQuery

## Active locations

25+ active locations across Ukraine, Poland, Czech Republic, and Germany.
Expanding to Dubai (UAE), Spain (Valencia, Madrid, Barcelona), and Switzerland (Zürich).
